name: outbid.lol — pay-to-rank product leaderboard by outbid.lol
description: A pay-to-rank leaderboard where the design gamifies scarcity: one hot-orange accent marks everything money-related — bid prices, active pills, the claim button — while the rest of the page stays near-monochrome. The hero compresses pitch and action into a single row (a live bid price with tiny steppers, a URL input, a category select, a claim button), then hands off to a dense 50-row feed in which the top three ranks are tinted peach, a live-activity strip interrupts after #10, and a 'TOP 20' pill divider resets the rhythm before progressively quieter mid-table rows finish in numbered pagination. Fully-rounded pill controls, tabular rank numerals, 12px meta labels and hairline dividers keep 2,870 products scannable; a compact sidebar mini-ranking and a three-card stats band close the page.
